assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production environment asset for BRINE underwater station builder. Chunky carefully rendered pixel-art material realism, selective fine detail, muted deep-ocean colors, restrained upper-left ambient light. STRICT DIRECT OVERHEAD camera, looking down at 85-90 degrees. No horizon, no isometric diamond, no frontal portrait perspective. No text, UI, labels, stations, characters, fantasy crystals, or glow. One edge-to-edge square ground material: Muted olive-grey fine sand with low flat dark green seagrass stubble and small broken shell grains, broad clear sediment lanes. No tall plants. Entire image filled with low-relief sediment to all edges, fully opaque. Natural irregular distribution with low contrast and no central focal subject. Designed to repeat as background beneath much brighter station rooms. No border or isolated foreground objects. 1536 square.
